content.short: NEAR Intents lets users state a desired swap and have solvers compete to fill it across chains.
content.description: NEAR Intents applies the intent model to cross-chain swapping: a user declares the outcome they want rather than the path to it, and a network of solvers competes to deliver the best price with on-chain settlement. Monad's documentation lists it under cross-chain tooling. The appeal is that routing complexity becomes the solver's problem rather than the user's.
